scope: One row per FY2027 HGAB 3rd-reading DPWH project row. Includes exact-ID review flags from the flags overview and detailed line-item review queue, plus missing-document flags for five named document types.
method: Document presence combines linked Proposal document types (direct title matches or selected NEP counterparts) and Senate HGAB title-linked document types. Named types are POW, BP 202, Development Council, geotagged photos, and Certificate of Implementability. A document type is counted present if either source has a match; complete means at least four of five types are matched. Existing review flags combine the flags overview and the detailed line-item review queue, joined only by exact HGAB ID; 95 rows have no exact review-flag record in either source. FMR-only manual reviews are not assigned to HGAB rows because their keys identify separate FMR records and do not establish an HGAB line-item match. A missing match is not proof that a document does not exist, and file presence does not verify contents.

sources.projectReviewFlags: Flags overview and detailed HGAB line-item review queue; exact HGAB ID joins only.
sources.proposalDocuments: Linked Proposal document coverage, including direct matches and selected NEP counterparts.
